title: WVP Shader (Wozt Vanilla Plus Shader)
description: Enhance your Minecraft with vibrant colors, warm lighting, and smooth performance. The ultimate Vanilla+ experience.
body:
![WVP SHADER](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/535649605df57209c27747f976872305f177f060.png)

Welcome to **WVP Shader**, a lightweight and performance-friendly Vanilla+ shader designed to enhance your Minecraft world with vibrant colors and cozy lighting while maintaining the classic vanilla aesthetic. 

🚀 **Perfect for low-end PCs and everyday gameplay!**

---

## ✨ Features
* 🎨 **Vibrant Colors & Cozy Lighting:** Enhanced tonemapping for a warm, lively, and immersive atmosphere.
* ☁️ **Custom Rounded 3D Clouds:** Gorgeous, stylized 3D blocky clouds that fit the Minecraft grid perfectly.
* 🌊 **Beautiful Clear Water:** Improved underwater visibility and realistic waving water effects.
* 🍃 **Waving Foliage:** Subtle, natural waving animations for leaves and plants.
* 🚀 **Performance First:** Highly optimized code. Enjoy high FPS even on integrated graphics!
* 🎮 **In-game Quality Profiles:** Easily toggle between **Potato, Medium, High, and Cinematic** presets in the shader options.

---

## 🛠️ Installation
1. Make sure you have **Iris Shader Mod** (recommended) or **OptiFine** installed.
2. Download the **WVP Shader** zip file.
3. Drop the zip file into your `.minecraft/shaderpacks` folder.
4. Enable it in-game via **Video Settings -> Shader Packs**.
